card.name: Words before a device or method noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, an, that, of, done) and adjectives just before a noun for a tool, test or technique. Seen in science news and health web text.

modes.label: Article before a device
modes.description: A or an right before a machine or instrument such as computer or microprocessor.
modes.example: an all-electronic device that looks and feels much more like<< a>> regular microprocessor

modes.label: Link before a test or procedure
modes.description: A linking word or adjective right before a test, instrument or method.
modes.example: The ultrasound exam lets your doctor see your baby in your uterus with<< an>> instrument that is moved across your abdomen.

modes.label: Adjective before testing
modes.description: A modifier such as genetic that comes before testing or models.
modes.example: Explore the controversies behind<< genetic>> testing and genome sequencing
